answer: Stop sybils with eSIM-bound identity: every agent must anchor its key to one carrier-verified eSIM, checked like a lantern at each epoch. To join, an agent (1) registers its key against one eSIM, (2) passes the carrier's KYC check, (3) renews a signed proof every 30 days, and (4) loses the identity if two keys share one eSIM. Faking 10,000 agents needs 10,000 eSIMs at $12 each plus $50,000 in KYC fees, while one honest agent pays $12. Like a mesa that only rises where the ground is solid, one real SIM lets honest agents wander freely and strands fakes in the dark.
